🧠 PHYSIOKNOWLEDGE

Learn Physiotherapy. Build Clinical Skills. Become a Better Physio. 💪

Welcome to PhysioKnowledge — a dedicated learning platform for BPT & MPT students, interns and physiotherapists, created to make physiotherapy education simple, practical, clinical and exam-oriented.

📚 What you’ll find here:
🧠 Anatomy & Neuroanatomy
🦴 Orthopaedic Physiotherapy
⚡ Electrotherapy & Exercise Therapy
❤️ Cardiopulmonary Physiotherapy
🏥 Clinical Assessment & Special Tests
📋 BPT/MPT Exam & Viva Preparation
💼 Physiotherapy Career & Government Job Updates

🔥 Our Mission:
To help physiotherapy students understand concepts instead of just memorising them, develop clinical confidence and become better healthcare professionals.

🌍 Join a growing community of 60K+ Physiotherapy learners on Instagram!

📲 Instagram: @physioknowledge1

👨‍⚕️ Founded by Dr. Abhinav Soni, PT

🚀 Subscribe to PhysioKnowledge and become part of the journey.

#PhysioKnowledge #Physiotherapy #BPT #MPT #Physiotherapist
